verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly documents a Bayesian statistics engine for experiment results and a dedicated experimentation/metrics framework, giving PMs a documented methodology behind results. However, the evidence pack shows no explicit mention of a frequentist alternative or variance-reduction techniques (e.g., CUPED), and there's no independent/hands-on corroboration of the engine's real-world reliability. missing for 10: frequentist option documentation, variance-reduction feature details, independent validation of statistical results.
